Name: Chicken Chicken Duck
Author: ElbuortSpo
Description:
[center][b][size=5][font=Arial Black]Chicken Chicken Duck - 鸡鸭杀[/font][/size][/b][/center]

[font=Comic Sans MS]Join the villagers in a playful social-deduction minigame! 和鹈鹕镇的村民们来一局紧张刺激的鸡鸭杀！[/font]
[quote]NPCs make decisions based on what they see, hear, and remember. NPC会根据自己的所见所闻和记忆作出判断。
They never peek at anyone's identity card through the system, 他们绝不会通过系统，直接得知任何人的身份底牌，
and they won't always take your word for it, and they can be wrong. 也不会百分之百相信你的发言, 也可能出错。
NPCs may also share useful information, giving you clues to work with. NPC会分享有用信息，为你的推理提供线索。
But stay alert, you can be knocked out too! 记得保持警惕，你也可能随时被刀哦！[/quote][left][/left]
[left][/left]
[left][size=4][font=Arial Black][b]How to play - 游戏方式[/b][/font][/size][/left]
[font=Arial Black]- Chicken[/font][font=Arial]: Complete all tasks or vote out every Duck. [/font][b][font=Arial Black]鸡[/font][/b][font=Arial Black]：[/font][font=Arial]完成所有任务或投出全部鸭子。[/font]
[font=Arial Black]- Duck:[/font][font=Arial] Eliminate the Chickens before they complete their tasks.[/font] [b][font=Arial Black]鸭子[/font][/b][font=Arial Black]：[/font][font=Arial]在鸡完成任务前持续使其减员。[/font]
[font=Arial Black]- Eggie[/font][font=Arial]: Get yourself voted out. (Advanced Difficulty only). [/font][font=Arial Black] [/font][b][font=Arial Black]蛋蛋[/font][/b][font=Arial Black]：[/font][font=Arial]让自己被投票出局（仅限进阶难度）。[/font]

[b][size=4][font=Arial Black]How to install - 安装指南[/font][/size][/b]
1. Install the latest version of SMAPI. 安装最新版 SMAPI。
2. Download this mod and extract it into the `Mods` folder shown by SMAPI. 下载本 Mod，解压到 SMAPI 指示的 Mods 文件夹。
3. Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI. 通过 SMAPI 启动星露谷即可。

[b][size=4][font=Arial Black]How it works - 游戏流程[/font][/size][/b]
On Spring 15 of Year 1, or the next in-game day after installing the mod in any save—
you will receive a letter from Lewis in the mailbox.
Read it, then speak to Lewis for the beginner tutorial.
Complete the tutorial to receive a souvenir statue.
Use it anytime to start another game and customize the NPC invitation list and difficulty.

第一年春15日，或安装Mod到任意存档的第二天，你会收到刘易斯的来信。
阅读邮件后，去找刘易斯对话即可开始新手教学。完成教学后获得纪念雕像。
之后可以随时通过雕像开启游戏，并自定义 NPC 邀请名单及游戏难度。

[b][size=4][font=Arial Black]Optional Settings - 自定义设置[/font]
[/size][/b]- Custom your portrait in meeting 自定义个人头像
name a square PNG of at least 64x64 pixels as "me.png" and place it in assets/portraits/...
将正方形，至少64×64像素的PNG图片命名为“me.png”，放入 assets/portraits/...文件夹中。

- Customize hotkeys and meeting duration through GMCM. This mod works normally without GMCM.
可通过GMCM自定义快捷键和会议时长，未安装GMCM也不影响 Mod 运行。

[b][size=4][font=Arial Black]Translations - 翻译[/font][/size][/b]
[font=Arial]Dialogue text is located in the i18n folder.
As updates may change the text, probably it's better to mention the corresponding mod version.
Thank you for your interest in the mod and for helping with translations!
[/font]
[font=Arial]对话文本位于i18n文件夹中。由于每次更新可能会调整文本，发布翻译时建议注明对应的Mod版本。
十分感谢对这个Mod感兴趣和愿意帮忙翻译的小伙伴![/font]

[size=4][font=Arial Black]Compatibility - Mod[/font][/size][b][size=4][font=Arial Black]兼容性[/font][/size][/b]
- Supports custom NPCs. 支持自定义NPC。
- Compatible with most User Interface, Portrait and Sprite Mods. 兼容大多美化Mod。
- Map modification Mods such as SVE, may cause task locations slightly offset, but gameplay is unaffected.
  使用SVE等涉及地图修改的Mod时，部分任务位置可能略有偏移，但不影响游玩。
- The beginner tutorial starts through Lewis. Compatibility is included for dialogue mods that may keep him occupied.
  新手教程需与刘易斯对话，已兼容可能占用刘易斯的对话Mod。

If any conflict remains, please contact me with the related mod name (if possible). 
如果仍有问题，请联系我并注明可能冲突的Mod名称（如果方便的话）。

[size=4][font=Arial Black]Multiplayer - [b]多人联机[/b][/font][/size]
[font=Arial]Multiplayer support is now available, but remains experimental and has not been fully tested. Further improvements are planned. 
多人联机功能现已开放，但仍属实验性支持，尚未经过充分测试，后续版本将继续完善。

If you run into any issues, feel free to leave a message or contact me. Have fun!
如有任何问题，欢迎留言或联系我。祝大家玩得开心！[/font]
